# PallmLaw

> PallmLaw is workflow and firm-intelligence software for Estate Planning firms. It helps firms track retained matters, automate matter workflows and client communication, identify stalled work, and measure operational performance.

Canonical website: https://pallmlaw.com
Former name: LawOps
Owner and operator: Pallm Tech LLC
Commercial focus: Estate Planning firms in the United States

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://pallmlaw.com/): Product overview and positioning
- [Platform](https://pallmlaw.com/platform): Platform architecture and operating model
- [Estate Planning](https://pallmlaw.com/estate-planning): Estate Planning workflow use case
- [Workflow Automation](https://pallmlaw.com/workflow-automation): Matter-stage, task, deadline, wait, and handoff automation
- [Client Communication](https://pallmlaw.com/client-communication-automation): Firm-controlled, workflow-triggered client communication
- [Firm Intelligence](https://pallmlaw.com/intelligence): Retention, cycle-time, workload, stalled-matter, and team-performance visibility
- [Matter Tracking](https://pallmlaw.com/matter-tracking-software-estate-planning): Estate Planning matter tracking and workflow control
- [AI Agent Connected](https://pallmlaw.com/ai-agent-connected): Governed, scoped, read-only access for approved AI tools
- [Fit Conversation](https://pallmlaw.com/fit): Qualification criteria and contact path

## Product boundaries

- PallmLaw is not positioned as a generic AI product or a replacement for every legal system.
- AI access is governed, read-only, scoped, audited, and user-attributed.
- Estate Planning is the current commercial focus.
- Product claims should be taken from the canonical PallmLaw pages above.
